_readme.what: Lootr already turns every structure chest, barrel, trapped chest and shulker box that has a loot table into a per-player Lootr container (lootr-common.toml). It can't convert other mods' loot containers (IE crates, Farmer's Delight cabinets/baskets, PneumaticCraft reinforced chests). Each entry below swaps that block for a vanilla container when a structure places it WITH a loot table, so Lootr converts it too: a crate becomes a Lootr barrel, a reinforced chest a Lootr chest.
_readme.rules: "block or glob": "target block". Globs use * ("farmersdelight:*_cabinet"). Only structure-placed blocks carrying a LootTable are swapped; player-placed containers, and containers with fixed contents and no loot table, are never touched. Facing/waterlogged carry over when the target has them. Read at every world load (patcherMod worldgen/LootContainerSwaps); only newly generated chunks are affected.
_readme.audit: loot_container_audit.md (python3 tools/audit_loot_containers.py) lists every container with a loot table in every structure template, and whether Lootr converts it, this file swaps it, or neither.
